name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants the European Union to do on humanitarian aid. It asks the European Union to defend international humanitarian law, protect aid workers, and make sure aid reaches civilians without obstruction. It wants more money for aid, more support for local aid groups and women's organisations, and a bigger share of funding delivered directly to local actors. It also asks the European Commission to report back on progress and keep Parliament involved. This is a set of requests and opinions, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act and report back.
- **Who it affects:** People in crisis zones, aid workers, and local aid groups.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must draw up a plan and report to Parliament.
